Name: PelicanWalk
Author: slpOff
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
PelicanWalk adds a simple pedometer system to Stardew Valley.
Walk around the valley to accumulate steps throughout the day, then convert them into Pelican Tokens. These tokens can be spent on useful rewards such as stat increases or special items.
The daily conversion limit is 1,000 steps, encouraging steady progress without making the system feel mandatory.
For players using smartphone-style UI mods, PelicanWalk includes compatibility support, allowing step counts, token information, and related features to integrate naturally into mobile-inspired gameplay experiences.
 
[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract PelicanWalk.[/*]
[*]Place the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]
• Tracks the number of steps your farmer takes.
• Convert steps into Pelican Tokens.
[list]
[*]100 steps = 1 token[/*]
[*]Maximum of 1,000 steps can be converted per day[/*]
[/list]• Spend earned tokens on various rewards.
[list]
[*]Permanent stat increases[/*]
[*]Useful items and consumables[/*]
[/list]• Smartphone mod compatibility support.
• Lightweight gameplay progression that rewards simply playing the game.
• Full i18n support.
• Translation-friendly structure. Anyone is welcome to create and share translations for additional languages.
 
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
• SMAPI 4.0 or later
No additional mods are required.
Optional: • Compatible smartphone UI mods for enhanced integration features.
